exemptions.reason: TOKEN SOURCE — Contains :root MD3 color token definitions (--md-sys-color-*: #hex). These ARE the token values, not violations.
TOKEN SOURCE — Contains :root MD3 color token definitions for light/dark modes. Hex values define the token system itself.
TOKEN SOURCE — lightColors/darkColors are MD3 source-of-truth color objects. eslint-disabled by design. See docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM_CONSOLIDATION.md § 5.
TOKEN SOURCE — Dark theme MD3 color token definitions. Hex values are required here.
TOKEN SOURCE — High-contrast accessibility token definitions. Hex values are required here.
THEME PRESETS — Color palette preset hex values for the UI theme picker. eslint-disabled. See THEME_CUSTOMIZATIONS export.
COLOR UTILITY — Color manipulation functions require hex as input. Values read from computedStyle at runtime.
PDF EXPORT — PDF rendering requires concrete hex values; CSS vars not supported in PDF context.
STORYBOOK DEMO — Color demonstration story showing token values. Hex values are display-only.
TOKEN SOURCE — Contains MD3 semantic token definitions with canonical pixel values. These ARE the token values.
ACCESSIBILITY TECHNIQUE — width: 1px / height: 1px is a standard visually-hidden pattern, not a design token violation.
HTML EMAIL TEMPLATE — PDF/email rendering requires concrete hex and px values; CSS custom properties are not supported in email HTML context.
ACCESSIBILITY OVERRIDE — Focus ring spread values (e.g. 0 0 0 6px) are accessibility requirements, not arbitrary spacing. Color uses MD3 token.
